name: graphiti
description: Graphiti temporal knowledge graph — episodic memory, contradiction detection, semantic search via FalkorDB

mcp_server.add_command: claude mcp add -t http -s project graphiti http://localhost:8100/mcp
setup_instructions: Registered automatically by `indusk init` and re-added by `indusk update` if missing.
The Graphiti MCP server runs inside the `indusk-infra` container on port 8100.
Exposes 9 tools: add_memory, search_nodes, search_memory_facts, get_episodes, get_entity_edge, delete_episode, delete_entity_edge, clear_graph, get_status.
